data.subject: ecoPTO meeting tomorrow (10/28) at 6pm
data.preheader: Join us for our October general meeting!
data.intro:
Join us for our monthly meeting on Wednesday, October 28 at 6pm. Bring your ideas and enthusiasm as we continue to plan programs and initiatives in support of Youth and Earth Wellbeing (Y.E.W.)!

We are meeting at the Broderick residence, 90 Crusher Road (park on the driveway of BeechTree Farm/105 Crusher Road across the street; park on the grass on the right side of the gravel road and walk up the driveway. )

See YEW there!
